message.traumacraft.not_applicable: This item cannot treat that injury
jei.traumacraft.bandage: Stops light or heavy bleeding on one selected body part. Pick up a bandage in inventory and click a body part in the TraumaCraft anatomy panel, or right-click to automatically treat the worst bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.splint: Fixes one broken limb. Pick up a splint and click the fractured body part in your inventory anatomy panel, or right-click to treat the first fracture.
jei.traumacraft.medkit: Restores 25 local HP to one body part. Hold on inventory cursor and click a body part in the anatomy panel to select it, or right-click to treat your most damaged body part.
jei.traumacraft.sterile_fabric: Clean cloth material used for dressings and medical kits.
jei.traumacraft.herbal_extract: A crafted botanical concentrate used in healing remedies.
jei.traumacraft.antiseptic: A refined medical reagent for emergency kits and injectors.
jei.traumacraft.syringe_body: Crafting component for prepared injection syringes.
jei.traumacraft.medical_polymer: Tough flexible material for braces, tourniquets and cases.
jei.traumacraft.sterile_patch: Restores 10 local HP to a living, damaged part. Does not work on a destroyed (0 HP) part.
jei.traumacraft.compression_wrap: Stops any bleeding on the selected zone and restores 5 local HP.
jei.traumacraft.hemostatic_gel: Stops heavy bleeding on the selected part and restores 15 local HP. Requires heavy bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.tourniquet: Stops heavy bleeding on one selected body part. Requires heavy bleeding.
jei.traumacraft.fracture_brace: Fixes one fracture and restores 10 local HP.
jei.traumacraft.bone_mender: Fixes one fracture, restores 25 local HP and grants Absorption I for 10 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.compact_medkit: Restores 18 local HP to one damaged body part above 0 HP.
jei.traumacraft.field_medkit: Restores 42 local HP, stops bleeding on one part and restores 2 vanilla HP (1 heart).
jei.traumacraft.trauma_kit: Restores 60 local HP, stops bleeding, fixes a fracture on one part and restores 6 vanilla HP (3 hearts).
jei.traumacraft.surgical_kit: Treats a destroyed 0-HP part: restores 35 local HP, stops bleeding and fixes a fracture.
jei.traumacraft.recovery_serum: Restores 8 local HP to every body part and grants Regeneration I for 15 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.adrenaline_injector: Grants Speed II and Strength I for 30 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.guardian_injector: Grants Resistance I and Absorption II for 40 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.focus_injector: Grants Haste II and Night Vision for 90 seconds.
jei.traumacraft.endurance_injector: Grants Speed I and Jump Boost II for 60 seconds.
